name: useq-mcp
description: US Equities (Alpaca) (trading): me, list_markets, get_ticker, get_balances, list_orders, place_order

platform_mcp_useq_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_USEQ_API_KEY
platform_mcp_useq_api_key.description: Alpaca API key id (APCA-API-KEY-ID). Paper keys (paper dashboard) work only on https://paper-api.alpaca.markets, the default here; live keys need adapter.base_url https://api.alpaca.markets.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Account status (must be ACTIVE), cash, buying_power, equity, trading_blocked.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every active US equity in one (large) response; `query` is not sent.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Market-data snapshot from data.alpaca.markets (same keys); the default feed is IEX unless the account has a SIP subscription.

tools.name: get_balances
tools.description: Open positions (holdings per symbol); cash and buying power are in `me`.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: `status` is open (Alpaca's default), closed or all; up to 500 orders.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places an order on the account behind the configured keys and host: paper trading by default (https://paper-api.alpaca.markets); if adapter.base_url is the live host it PLACES A REAL ORDER WITH REAL FUNDS. Keep testing on paper and never place an order the user has not explicitly confirmed. Orders are DAY orders; limit orders need `price`, omit it for market orders. Insufficient buying power is answered with HTTP 403 and surfaces as auth_error.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Accepted with HTTP 204; an order that is no longer cancelable is rejected with 422.
